title: Solid continuous page flow
summary: Primary screens now move as fully opaque full-size pages on one horizontal track, eliminating the visual overlap between adjacent screens.
changes: Night, Changes, Breaks and Chat remain full-size and fully opaque while sliding, with their edges meeting directly as one page leaves and the next enters.
The scale and transparency morph introduced in 37.42 has been removed because it could make two screens appear on top of one another during a swipe.
Swipe settling, bottom-tab taps and long bottom-bar drags now share the same 260 ms horizontal easing, and the selected tab indicator follows the same timing.
Vertical scrolling, protected controls, Chat interactions, reduced-motion behaviour, roster calculations, Supabase data and authentication are unchanged.
